title: Home-Office Deduction Organizer (US)

reasons: market_reality: no sourced competitor prices and no recorded proof of payment

market_reality_note: market_reality is MISSING_DATA for every product in this factory: no sourced competitor prices and no recorded founder payment evidence are wired into the harness. That is a harness limitation, not a product verdict, and it is why the overall enforcer verdict reads BLOCKED_MISSING_DATA while both scored layers pass.

independent_value_verification.method: expected values recomputed in Python from the shipped example inputs and compared against Excel's own recalculated values; guards exercised by running the same real probe over deliberately broken copies

structural.note: both artifacts PASS structurally (PDF and XLSX); the same tool the fleet QA uses

price.why_no_change: A price change is a founder decision; this repair changes content and formulas only. The figure below is disclosed, not applied.
price.economics_module: economics.market_realism_check (two ceilings, the stricter wins: price/page_count <= max_price_per_page_usd, and books under 30 pages capped at $15.00 outright)
price.finding: At the guide's 7 pages the general digital tier caps this product at $7.00 (the per-page ceiling binds before the $15 short-book rule), so the $29 manifest price would be silently re-priced to $7.00 by the auto-distribution path. On the premium curated tier the same $29 is accepted, because that tier is calibrated for expertise and curation rather than pages.
price.policy_limitation: The page policy counts PDF pages only. The workbook is a 7-sheet, 111-formula tool that the policy does not see at all - the same shape the B12-010 gate disclosed for its own workbook.
price.not_padded: The guide was extended to 3,352 words of real content; no filler was added to raise the page count toward a price ceiling.

blocking_next: Price tier decision: $7.00 honest ceiling on the general digital tier versus the $29 manifest price (which the premium curated tier accepts).
Listing publication remains behind the standing write gate: FACTORY_LIVE_PUBLISH is not true and no scoped authorization exists.
